Complements subdivision.rs.
title: outram-blender: Loop subdivision (triangle subdivision surface)

description: GH #37 §D. Edge-length / face-area / face-angle / dihedral computation; ruler+protractor measurement with snapping; persistent dimension annotations (MeasureIt-style); set-exact-size from item dimensions; Mesh Analysis (overhang, thickness, self-intersect, distortion, sharp) for manufacturability / meshing readiness.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content: src/measure.rs (new, ~430 LOC + 7 tests): per-element (edge_length, face_area Newell, face_perimeter, dihedral_angle, corner_angle); whole-mesh (total_edge_length, total_surface_area, signed_volume via divergence theorem, bounding_box, dimensions); Ruler.distance / Protractor.angle; mesh analysis (overhang vs up-vector, distortion = max per-triangle-normal angle, sharp_edges(angle), self_intersections = AABB broad phase + tri-tri intersect skipping vertex-adjacent faces, thickness = Moller-Trumbore ray cast along -normal). Verified: cube 24 area/edge/vol 8/dims, 90deg dihedrals, ruler 3-4-5, overhang top~0 bot~pi, distortion flat=0 bent>0.1, crossing quads = 1 intersection + clean cube = 0, slab thickness ~0.3. clippy clean.

title: outram-blender: measurement & inspection (length/area/angle overlays, ruler+protractor, dimension annotations, mesh analysis)
